scope: Conditional owned-TLS origin capture, SFUN lease publication, collective retirement and join composition; not arbitrary foreign threads, C weak-memory refinement, complete GC or native admission.

cases.scope: One removed OS-thread origin and retained coordinator; bounded marker relocation; successful join or a retained pending-join error. Capture-to-publication has no interrupt/GC safepoint. Assumes VM/pstate backing storage is not independently destroyed by an uncoordinated host cleanup, valid TLS is owned by the current OS thread, and coherent atomic admission. Weak fairness establishes abstract completion, not latency. Two injected controls reject early backing-store destruction and escaped TLS after join; neither is attributed to PR988. Excludes raw external FFI entry, PSTATE_BIND users, pointer-generation reuse, full join retry, OS implementation and full parallel GC.
